verdict.rationale: Braintrust is a SaaS observability and eval platform that stores customer traces and datasets, so whether that data is used for AI training is a fair question. The pack has no statement about training-use policy or an opt-out. The self-hosting option, which keeps data in your own cloud account for residency and compliance, is an adjacent control and does not document that data is excluded from model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
